description: Track policy and reputation blocks separately from hard and soft bounces
checkSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS present FROM pragma_table_info('subscribers') WHERE name = 'block_bounce_count'

description: Configure campaign reply addresses per newsletter
checkSql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('newsletters') WHERE name = 'reply_to_address') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('newsletters') WHERE name = 'reply_to_author') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('campaigns') WHERE name = 'reply_to_address') = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS present
